verdict.rationale: The only retention-related evidence is that paste history saving to disk is opt-in ("you can even opt to have the history saved to disk"), which gives users some control over whether that one data type persists. Nothing in the pack documents retention or deletion controls for scrollback, shell-integration command history, session-restoration state, instant replay, or AI chat data. Missing for 10: documented deletion/clearing controls, retention settings for command history, scrollback and restored sessions, AI-chat data retention policy, and independent corroboration.
